title: FTC v. Meta structural antitrust litigation (Instagram / WhatsApp divestiture remedy sought)

business_activity.name: Instagram and WhatsApp within Family of Apps

authority: Federal Trade Commission / US District Court for the District of Columbia
policy_mechanism: Enforcement action with court remedy: permanent injunction and equitable relief including divestiture or reconstruction of Instagram and WhatsApp

mechanism_chain.text: The FTC filed a complaint in December 2020 alleging anticompetitive conduct including the Instagram (2012) and WhatsApp (2014) acquisitions.
The complaint seeks equitable relief including divestiture or reconstruction of Instagram and WhatsApp.
A structural remedy would separate core revenue-generating products from Meta; the CMA-ordered Giphy divestiture in 2023 shows such remedies are executed in practice.
Instagram-specific revenue is not disclosed, so the financial scale of a divestiture cannot be computed from public filings.

events.description: FTC files complaint in D.D.C. alleging Section 5 FTC Act / Section 2 Sherman Act violations
Precedent: Meta completes Giphy divestiture under UK CMA order
Meta FY2025 10-K continues to disclose the suit and the divestiture remedy sought

financial_linkage.detail: Instagram and WhatsApp results are reported only within the Family of Apps segment; no product-level revenue is disclosed.
financial_linkage.gap: Cannot assign product-level exposure from consolidated or segment revenue - Unknown on the financial linkage ladder.

rationale: The remedy sought strikes at core business assets, which makes business exposure Core by construction. But the case rests entirely on company disclosure of the litigation; no court-docket connector exists in this build, so current procedural posture (post-trial status, remedy phase) is a material coverage gap. No outcome probability is claimed.
gaps: No court docket connector (PACER/D.D.C.) - the current litigation posture cannot be independently verified in this build.
Remedy scope and timing unknown; time horizon is Unclear by design.
